description: Defines the ProjectValidationEvent class for validating project data within the Goteo application, including scoring and error tracking for various project sections.

classes.name: ProjectValidationEvent
classes.description: Handles validation and scoring of project data, tracking errors and fields for different project sections.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates scores for each project section and overall global score based on validation methods.

methods.name: getProfileScore
methods.description: Calculates score for the profile section based on owner data.

methods.name: getPersonalScore
methods.description: Calculates score for personal information section.

methods.name: getOverviewScore
methods.description: Calculates score for project overview details.

methods.name: getImagesScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on project image presence.

methods.name: getCostsScore
methods.description: Calculates score for project costs information.

methods.name: getRewardsScore
methods.description: Calculates score for project rewards details.

methods.name: getCampaignScore
methods.description: Calculates score for campaign contact information.
